name: Inca Garcilaso de la Vega
shortBio: Cuzco-born mestizo Incan philosopher and humanist; author of Comentarios Reales de los Incas, pioneering the intercultural synthesis of Incan imperial cosmology, Quechua hermeneutics, and Renaissance Neoplatonism.
centralQuestion: Did pre-conquest Incan civilization possess a rational, natural moral order and monotheistic contemplation of Pachacamac comparable to ancient Greek and Roman philosophy?

keyWorks.title: Comentarios Reales de los Incas (Royal Commentaries of the Incas)
keyWorks.description: Masterwork preserving Incan statecraft, agrarian socialism, cosmic religion, and Quechua poetry against Spanish misrepresentation.

keyWorks.title: Translation of León Hebreo's Dialoghi d'Amore (Dialogues of Love)
keyWorks.description: Exemplary Spanish translation of the seminal Renaissance Neoplatonic treatise on cosmic love and universal harmony.
